info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Document By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Document Archive API enables users to modify archived documents based on a specific parameter. This operation allows for efficient document management, ensuring that updates can be made to existing records without requiring full replacements. Typical consumers of this API include banking and financial institutions that need to keep their archived documents current and accurate in compliance with regulations. This API enhances data integrity and simplifies retrieval processes by maintaining the relevance of archived documentation.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the properties of a specific Document Archive Service. Ensure that you provide the correct fields in the request to modify its state effectively.

requestBody.description: Updates the specified document in the archive services. This request allows you to modify existing document details and state information.
